skill.name: gate-exchange-spot
skill.description: Use this skill for Gate spot trading workflows, including balance checks, market and limit order drafts, cancellations, amendments, fill verification, portfolio valuation, and asset swaps.
skill.summary: Guides Gate spot trading workflows with checks, order drafts, confirmations, and result reports.
skill.author: gate

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, shell execution, or credential exfiltration was found in the reviewed files. The static external-command and system-reconnaissance findings are Markdown/tool-name false positives, and the README API-key hits are placeholder setup examples. One medium semantic risk remains because cancel-all workflows can change open orders without the same explicit confirmation gate used for order placement.

remediation.issue: Cancel-all order workflows can run without a dedicated confirmation gate.
remediation.suggestion: Add a mandatory cancellation draft and explicit confirmation before cancel_all_spot_orders or cancel_spot_order, including pair scope and affected order count.

remediation.issue: README examples show API credentials inline with shell commands.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a protected environment file or secret manager, and warn that real write mode can affect live Gate orders.

remediation.issue: The skill handles high-impact financial execution workflows.
remediation.suggestion: State clearly that users supply trading decisions and that the skill only checks rules, drafts orders, and reports exchange results.

semantic_findings.title: State-Changing Cancellation Lacks Explicit Confirmation Gate
semantic_findings.description: The skill routes cancel-all order requests to cancel_all_spot_orders, while the mandatory confirmation rule is scoped to create_spot_order. Canceling open orders changes financial exposure and should require a draft plus explicit confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation directly maps cancel-all workflows to a state-changing cancellation tool, and the strongest confirmation section only names order placement. The risk is procedural rather than hidden code execution.

content.value_statement: Spot traders need clear checks before orders, cancellations, and swaps. This skill guides Gate spot workflows with balance checks, order drafts, confirmations, and result reports.
actual_capabilities: Maps Gate spot tasks to account, order, market data, fee, and trading-rule tools.
Builds order drafts for market and limit buys or sells before execution.
Checks balances, minimum amounts, precision, and tradability before order placement.
Handles open order listing, cancellations, amendments, fill checks, and holdings reports.
Supports conditional limit workflows, asset swaps, fee estimates, and portfolio valuation.
limitations: Does not provide investment advice or decide what is financially suitable.
Does not support native take-profit or stop-loss trigger orders.
Requires user-provided Gate API access through connected tools; it does not include credentials.
Does not run a background watcher; conditions are evaluated during the active request.

use_cases.title: Pre-Trade Checks
use_cases.description: A trader checks balances, rules, and current prices before approving a Gate spot order.

use_cases.title: Order Cleanup
use_cases.description: An operations user reviews open orders, cancels stale orders, and confirms refreshed balances.

use_cases.title: Post-Trade Verification
use_cases.description: A portfolio user verifies fills, fees, cost basis, and current holdings after a buy or sell.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Buy
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether I have enough USDT to buy 100 USDT of BTC. Show the rules, current price, and an order draft if eligible.

prompt_templates.title: Create Limit Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a limit buy draft for ETH at 3000 USDT. Verify my balance, minimum amount, and price precision before asking for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Open Orders
prompt_templates.prompt: List my open BTC_USDT orders. If any buy order is unfilled, show options to cancel or amend it before taking action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Asset Swap
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate swapping all DOGE to BTC if the DOGE value is at least 10 USDT. Show each leg and require separate confirmations.

output_examples.input: Can I buy 100 USDT of BTC?
output_examples.output: Eligibility checked. BTC_USDT is tradable, balance is sufficient, and an order draft is ready. It will wait for explicit confirmation.
Latest buy fill found with filled quantity, average price, fees, and current ETH holding total.

output_examples.input: Cancel open BTC orders and show balance.
output_examples.output: Open orders are canceled or reported as already filled, then refreshed USDT and BTC balances are shown.

best_practices: Require a fresh explicit confirmation after each order draft before placing any trade.
Check balance, tradability, minimum amount, precision, and fees before proposing an order.
Report prices, quantities, order status, and balance changes in plain language after each action.
anti_patterns: Do not treat old confirmations as approval for a changed order.
Do not use market orders when the user requested a target or conditional limit price.
Do not present trading choices as financial advice or guaranteed outcomes.

faq.question: Can this skill place real Gate spot orders?
faq.answer: Yes, when connected to Gate trading tools and after explicit user confirmation for order placement.

faq.question: Does it store API keys?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation does not store credentials. API access must be handled by the user tool environment.

faq.question: Does it support take-profit or stop-loss orders?
faq.answer: No. It says TP/SL trigger orders are unsupported and suggests manual limit workflows.

faq.question: Can it cancel or amend orders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide cancellation and amendment workflows, but state-changing actions should be confirmed by the user.

faq.question: Can it value my portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses spot balances and ticker prices to estimate USDT-equivalent value.

faq.question: Is it financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes exchange workflows and reports data; users decide whether a trade is suitable.
